audit_note: If cytotoxic NKG7/GNLY is high, distinguish T from NK using CD3/TRBC.
Plasma/ASC should be separated even when derived from B lineage.
MS4A1 can be low/absent; immunoglobulin genes alone are insufficient because of ambient RNA.
CD3/TRBC positive -> NKT/T; CD3/TRBC absent/low -> NK.

positive_gate: LYZ; LST1; AIF1 and/or DC-specific HLA/CD1C/CLEC genes
audit_note: Recluster before annotation; macrophage, monocyte and DC states are biologically distinct.
For malignant/TET-specific states, CNV/aneuploidy is supportive and preferable where available.

positive_gate: LUM; CCDC80; FN1; PDGFRA and subtype markers
audit_note: TET-FB is an ECM/TGF-beta-rich disease-associated state.
Use RGS5/PDGFRB/MCAM to distinguish from fibroblast and endothelial cells.
